<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916627_theRebbe_635" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916627_theRebbe_635__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The animal soul considers it foolish to exchange spiritual pleasure for physical pleasure, which derives only from the waste of the higher realms and the level of angels called "keruvim," especially when it destroys the source of spiritual pleasure.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">The animal soul</t>
    <t s="1">[is called] "behemah" (beast),</t>
    <t s="2">(and likewise the divine soul)</t>
    <t s="3">because it is foolishness to turn and exchange for physical pleasure,</t>
    <t s="4">since it is drawn only from the waste of the higher realms,</t>
    <t s="5">which is the matter of the angels called "keruvim,"</t>
    <t s="6">and especially when this destroys the spiritual pleasure, their source.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Those without daat may understand but lack conscious awareness, unlike the holy foolishness of the Mishkan made from shittim wood, which brings the Divine indwelling.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">(Addition from Sefer HaToldot)</t>
    <t s="1">that they have no daat (intellective awareness),</t>
    <t s="2">even though they understand,</t>
    <t s="3">but this is not with recognition and feeling</t>
    <t s="4">(in brief in Kuntres HaTefillah,</t>
    <t s="5">and at length in the continuation of the discourse of the Tzemach Tzedek),</t>
    <t s="6">the opposite of kavanah (intention).</t>
    <t s="7">But through the holy foolishness,</t>
    <t s="8">"make a Mishkan of shittim wood,"</t>
    <t s="9">and then "I will dwell within them."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Just as in the Mishkan the actual indwelling of the Shechinah came through Moshe and Aharon, through the union of the letters of the Name and the love of Israel, so too the manifestation of Moshe and Aharon comes through the love of Israel.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Just as in the Mishkan the actual indwelling of the Shechinah came through Moshe and Aharon,</t>
    <t s="1">through the union of the letters of the Name and the union of the letters of the Name and the Name,</t>
    <t s="2">through the love of Israel,</t>
    <t s="3">so too the manifestation of Moshe and Aharon comes through the love of Israel.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
